facts.text: I attended the Billie Eilish concert at the Los Angeles Forum on March 14th, 2023.
I went to the Billie Eilish concert with my best friend, Rachel.
I had floor seats at the Billie Eilish concert.
I got there early and managed to grab a spot close to the stage at the Billie Eilish concert.
The opening act at the Billie Eilish concert was Olivia Dean.
I met Billie Eilish briefly after the Billie Eilish concert and took a photo together.
I did not attend the Governors Ball Music Festival.
Before the H.E.R. concert, I attended the Imagine Dragons concert at the Banc of California Stadium.
